rawSnippet:
show ip route vrf *
% Command timed out after 45.000s
[SSH Session Keepalive dropped during 142,000 route table buffer dump]
rootCause: Routing table buffer size exceeded SSH channel timeout (45s). BGP/VRF route table has 142k entries without chunked pagination.
remediation: Enable chunked table pagination ('terminal length 0' + paging flag) or adjust per-command timeout threshold to 90s in discovery settings.
impact: Incomplete L3 routing graph for HQ-DC1; VRF route leaks unmapped.

Platform: cisco AIR-AP3802I-E-K9,  Capabilities: Trans-Bridge
Interface: GigabitEthernet0/24,  Port ID (outgoing port): GigabitEthernet0
rootCause: IOS 15.2(7)E7 output format altered the platform header comma spacing ('cisco AIR-AP3802I-E-K9,  Capabilities:'), causing regex pattern '^Platform: (?P<model>[^\n]+)' to fail capture.
remediation: Update regex parser rule for Cisco IOS CDP table to handle trailing comma and arbitrary whitespace before Capabilities field.
impact: CDP neighbor link to AP ap-floor1-02 not established in L2 topology graph.

rawSnippet: ssh: connect to host 10.40.1.1 port 22: Connection timed out via jumphost-eu-west-01 (192.168.100.5)
rootCause: Jumphost security group blocked outbound TCP/22 to 10.40.1.0/24 following Madrid branch firewall migration.
remediation: Update security group on jumphost-eu-west-01 to permit TCP/22 outbound to branch subnet 10.40.1.0/24.
impact: Branch-Madrid site entirely unreached; 0/1 devices discovered.

CLISH: Unknown command 'show routed cluster-state'. Available commands:
  show cluster members
  show cluster status
rootCause: Gaia R81.20 deprecated 'show routed cluster-state' in favor of 'show cluster members' and 'cphaprob stat' in expert mode.
remediation: Add version-conditional command execution: use 'show cluster members' for Check Point Gaia >= R81.10.
impact: HA cluster state and VIP redundancy status unparsed for Check Point firewall.

rawSnippet: % Command authorization failed for user 'svc_ipf_ro' on VTY 1 (Privilege Level 7)
rootCause: TACACS+ authorization rule assigned privilege level 7 to discovery service account, but 'show mac address-table' requires level 15 on this platform.
remediation: Update TACACS+ command authorization rule to grant privilege level 15 or explicitly permit 'show mac address-table' for 'svc_ipf_ro'.
impact: Layer 2 MAC forwarding table missing on Branch-London access switch; endpoint attachment points unmapped.

command: show bgp neighbor summary | display json
rawSnippet: syntax error, expecting <command>: | display json on Junos 21.4R3-S5 non-REST CLI mode
rootCause: Junos non-REST SSH session rejected '| display json' pipe when session was opened in pure text terminal mode.
remediation: Fallback to standard Junos CLI XML/text parser when '| display json' is rejected on legacy SSH channels.
impact: BGP peer state normalized via text fallback with 420ms parsing delay.
